name: STAR Statistics — least-squares line and correlation, correctly rounded
summary: Least-squares straight line, standard errors of slope and intercept, residual standard deviation and Pearson correlation computed exactly in rational arithmetic and rounded once; on 500 datasets all six results are identical to the exact rational value from SymPy; reproduces the five certified values of the NIST Norris dataset to 1e-13 relative.
reference: NIST StRD linear regression, dataset Norris: slope 1.00211681802045, intercept -0.262323073774029, standard errors 0.429796848199937E-03 and 0.232818234301152, residual standard deviation 0.884796396144373

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: arguments (xs, ys); errors with n - 2 degrees of freedom
review.G-06: the NIST Norris data are written in the cross-check driver and in FACTS.md; the rest of the corpus is generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for a degenerate fit; the assumptions behind the standard errors are stated as not checked
